metadata.source: EPA Smart Location Database v3.0 (NatWalkInd), via data/market/epa_sld_co.json
metadata.geometry: Block-group area centroids from data/market/epa_sld_bg_geometry_co.geojson (2010 block groups)
metadata.note: One display point per block group. The PMA analysis matches sites to block-group polygons, not to these points. walk_score is NatWalkInd (1-20) rescaled to 0-100. Rebuild via scripts/market/build_walkability_layer.py.
